Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Does the Pink Treatment hurt?

Very minimal discomfort. The patented micro-needles are ultra-fine. Most clients describe a mild tingling sensation. No numbing is typically needed, and the procedure takes just 20â30 minutes.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session â increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2â4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2â3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

The recommended protocol is 3 sessions bi-weekly, then 3 sessions monthly (6 total). Maintenance every 3â6 months. Many clients see visible improvement from the very first session.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Absolutely! Pink Treatment pairs beautifully with AQUAGOLD, HydraFacial, Botox, and LED therapy. Dr. Geetika often creates combined anti-aging protocols for comprehensive results.

Why is it called the Pink Treatment?

Named for the signature pink hue of the 56-component formula and the beautiful pink glow it gives your skin. It's a beloved K-Beauty treatment that has become a cult favorite at ISAAC Luxe.
